images.source: Wikimedia Commons references explicitly attached to OSM features
images.policy: Only Public Domain, CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA; preserve creator, credit, page and license links

overture.license: Per-record source licenses preserved in details_json.sources
overture.compression: gzip; decompress before opening as SQLite

openstreetmap.compression: gzip; decompress before opening as SQLite

notes: Each provider is kept in its own SQLite file to preserve provenance and license boundaries.
Phone, website, hours, descriptions, payment/services and images remain empty when the source does not provide them.
The county Business Tracker and Overture do not provide per-place photos or opening hours in their current schemas; OSM tags and Commons references may fill some gaps.
Public downloadable SQLite files are gzip-compressed to reduce transfer size; decompress before opening with SQLite.
The Miami-Dade LocalBusinessTax layer is excluded: official metadata restricts it to internal use and states telephone data is not public.
